packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-0.x patch/minor once CI (lint/typecheck/test/build + audits) is green.
0.x deps: a 0.x MINOR is the breaking step under cargo/npm caret semantics, so it never auto-merges. (0.x patches are compatible and auto-merge via the rule below.)
0.x PATCH (0.8.1 -> 0.8.2) is semver-compatible under both cargo and npm caret rules, so it gets the same treatment as a >=1.0 patch: auto-merge once CI is green.
Group Radix UI primitives into one PR.
Group TanStack libraries.

react + react-dom must move in lockstep — react-dom's dev builds hard-fail at module load when the versions differ, so a standalone bump of either can never pass the web test job (PRs #521/#522 proved it).
Majors always require human review + migration.

eslint 10 is blocked by eslint-plugin-react, pulled in transitively via eslint-config-next (which depends on eslint-plugin-react ^7.37.0). Its latest release, 7.37.5, peer-supports eslint up to ^9.7 only and calls the rule-context API context.getFilename(), which eslint 10 removed (now context.filename). Flat config is already in use (web/eslint.config.mjs) — that is NOT the blocker. Clears only when eslint-plugin-react ships an eslint-10-compatible release AND eslint-config-next adopts it.

typescript 7 is the native-compiler (tsgo) rewrite; its JS compiler API is not a drop-in replacement. openapi-typescript (the `just openapi` codegen) crashes on it (ts.factory.createKeywordTypeNode undefined) and the web lint/typecheck job crashes on ModuleKind.Cjs. Clears when openapi-typescript and the rest of the TS-compiler-API tooling ship typescript-7 support; retest by re-running CI on the renovate branch. Minors within 6.x keep flowing through the normal automerge rule.

@types/node major must track the Node runtime major, currently 24 (engines.node >=24, .nvmrc, ci.yml node-version, web/Dockerfile node:24). Don't let @types/node run ahead of the runtime; bump both together when Node moves. Minors/patches within 24.x auto-merge.

Known breaking-within-minor packages (2026-06 audit found code-migration needs in minor/0.x bumps). react-hook-form/resolvers and react-query were migrated in Stage 3 but stay flagged (future minors have shipped breaking type changes). openapi-typescript needs a matching scripts/build-types-shim.py update before bumping past 7.4.
Rust HTTP-client trio must move together (oauth2/openidconnect pin reqwest 0.12).
sea-orm pins sqlx (sea-orm 1.1.x → sqlx 0.8.x). Never bump sqlx standalone — it won't co-resolve. Move as one PR; sqlx 0.9 waits for sea-orm 2.x.
apalis pins the redis crate (apalis-redis 0.6.x → redis 0.27.x). The redis crate never bumps standalone — it moves with apalis/apalis-redis.

testcontainers-modules exact-tracks the testcontainers minor (0.15 → testcontainers ^0.27), and both pull bollard, which exact-pins bollard-stubs. Bumping testcontainers alone makes the two bollard majors demand conflicting bollard-stubs versions and cargo fails to resolve before it compiles anything. Move as one PR; a testcontainers minor waits for the matching testcontainers-modules release.

RustCrypto digest/rand ecosystem moves in lockstep — digest 0.11 (sha2 0.11 / hmac 0.13) and rand 0.10 are breaking jumps that the AEAD/signature crates (argon2, rsa, ed25519-dalek, chacha20poly1305) pin transitively. Group so they never surface as conflicting standalone bumps; needs code migration.
GitHub Actions: digest pins + patch/minor auto-merge once CI is green. Majors stay behind the major-review rule.

pnpm security overrides — matched by FILE (the depType-based match never fired; #378 proved it) are temporary pins onto a patched line — bumping them to a new MAJOR is meaningless churn (the js-yaml v5 PR case). Patch/minor within the pinned line stays enabled; delete each override outright once dependents' ranges clear the vulnerable versions.

Dev/test/prod infrastructure images (postgres/redis/dex/alpine/curl in compose files, and the Dockerfile base images) never auto-merge a TAG change - a postgres major needs a data-dir migration plan, and dev must stay on the same major CI tests against. Digest-only refreshes of the pinned tags are handled by the digest rule below.

The Rust toolchain moves atomically: rust-toolchain.toml, the Dockerfile `rust:X.Y` builder tag and every dtolnay/rust-toolchain@<version> workflow ref land in one PR, or CI compiles with a different rustc than the repo pins. Minor/patch toolchain bumps auto-merge: clippy runs with -D warnings, the whole suite and the Docker build+smoke run on the new compiler, so a bump that breaks anything simply stays open. NOTE: CI jobs pin dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.96.0 on purpose - that is the MSRV (Cargo.toml rust-version) and dtolnay publishes those refs as branches, not tags, so Renovate cannot bump them; bumping MSRV is a human decision made in Cargo.toml + ci.yml together.

Digest refresh of an already-pinned image tag (e.g. postgres:18-alpine@sha256:...) is the upstream rebuilding the same tag with newer OS packages - exactly what the CVE scan wants us to take. Nothing an operator chose changes, and CI boots the images (smoke test), so auto-merge.

reqwest is held at 0.12 (see the Cargo.toml comment block): oauth2/openidconnect pin 0.12 in their feature graphs and a local bump pulls two reqwest versions side-by-side. A config-level ceiling beats closed-PR memory (branch cleanup wiped that once and the update resurrected as #350). Remove when oauth2 ships reqwest-0.13 support.

pnpm is pinned in three places (package.json/packageManager, pnpm/action-setup in the workflows, `npm install -g pnpm@` in web/Dockerfile). One PR moves all of them. pmOnFail: ignore in pnpm-workspace.yaml keeps the pin out of pnpm-lock.yaml, so a pin-only bump passes --frozen-lockfile (#768).

Weekly batch of web dev-tooling (vitest/vite, prettier, tailwind, testing-library, playwright, ...) minors+patches: one PR on Monday instead of a trickle. Excludes the packages with their own gate rules and the nextjs monorepo group (eslint-config-next must move with next). 0.x members stay individual so the 0.x rules apply cleanly.

Web RENDER-PATH minors wait for a human until the Playwright reader-flow gate runs in CI. The vitest suite has no DOM environment (everything is renderToStaticMarkup), nothing renders Reader.tsx / PageImage.tsx / any page.tsx, and the Docker smoke only asserts a sign-in <form> - so a hydration- or event-handler-level regression in these libraries is invisible to CI today. Patches still auto-merge (bugfix-only by convention; the smoke test catches boot breaks like v0.27.5). Delete this rule when the e2e job lands - see docs/dev/dependency-management.md.
Mend Merge Confidence "low" means other repos reported regressions on this exact release. Hold it for a look even when CI is green - CI cannot see what it does not test.
`folio:dev` / `folio-web:dev` in compose.test.yml are built locally by `just docker-build`, not pulled from a registry - nothing to look up.

customManagers.description: web/Dockerfile installs pnpm with `npm install -g pnpm@X.Y.Z`; keep it on the same version as package.json/packageManager and the pnpm/action-setup pins (grouped as `pnpm` below).
